title: Statistical methods to model and evaluate physical activity programs
author: S.S.M. Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tsvene6

steps.title: Perform Database Search
steps.instruction: Search PubMed/Medline, Web of Science, and CINAHL for English language articles published between January 1, 2000, and August 1, 2017, using individualized keywords.

substeps.instruction: PubMed search: accelerometer OR pedometer OR step count* OR "Fitness Trackers"[Mesh] AND statistic* OR statistical model* OR quantitative OR "Models, Statistical"[Mesh] OR "Data Mining"[Mesh] OR "Data Interpretation, Statistical"[Mesh] AND "Exercise"[Mesh] OR "physical activity" OR fitness OR Program* OR intervention

PsycINFO search: accelerometer OR pedometer OR step count* OR "Fitness Trackers" AND statistic* OR statistical model* OR quantitative OR "Statistical Analysis"[Index Term] OR "Data Mining"[Index Term] OR "Data Interpretation" AND "Exercise"[Index Term] OR "physical activity" OR fitness OR Program* OR intervention

Web of Science search: accelerometer OR pedometer OR step count* OR "Fitness Trackers" AND statistic* OR statistical model* OR quantitative OR "Data Mining" OR "Data Interpretation" AND "Exercise" OR "physical activity" OR fitness OR Program* OR intervention

steps.title: Screen Articles Based on Inclusion Criteria
steps.instruction: Select articles that meet all the following criteria: (i) include data from a physical activity program or intervention; (ii) data collection did not impact natural lifestyle (exclude treadmill or walking tests); (iii) include at least one group of healthy participants; (iv) include a study variable related to 'step counts' collected via pedometer or accelerometer; (v) perform quantitative analysis using 'statistical modeling'.

steps.title: Filter and Review Literature
steps.instruction: Manage and screen the identified articles through a multi-stage review process.

substeps.instruction: Upload search results to EndNote and remove duplicates (performed by first author).
Independently screen titles and abstracts against inclusion criteria (performed by first two authors).
Resolve questionable eligibility of articles via a third reviewer.
Perform independent full-text reviews of shortlisted articles to confirm inclusion criteria.
Resolve any remaining questionable articles via the third author.

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.instruction: Extract information from selected papers into two structured tables.

substeps.instruction: Maintain a table including general paper information and the statistical methods used.
Maintain a second table including the previous columns, significant predictors of the study, and p-values.

steps.title: Document Search Process
steps.instruction: Plot the entire search and selection process, including main reasons for rejections, in a PRISMA flow diagram.

steps.title: Assess Study Quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate the quality of included articles using the Downs and Black assessment tool for health care interventions.

substeps.instruction: Apply the 27-item checklist across five sub-scales: reporting (10 items), external validity (3 items), bias (7 items), confounding (6 items), and power (1 item).
Categorize quality: High (22-25), Moderate (18-21), and Low (14-17).

steps.title: Present Results
steps.instruction: Use a taxonomy of statistical techniques to present the results generated from the data extraction tables.
